info.name: 09. Maintenance Costs
info.description:
Vehicle maintenance cost management with structured cost IDs.

## Cost Structure
All costs require:
- `cost_id`: Unique identifier (e.g., VMC-002-003)
- `cost_label`: Display label (e.g., Tyres Replacement)
- `group_id`: Group identifier (e.g., VMC-G-002)

## Cost Groups

**VMC-G-001 - Regular Maintenance:**
- VMC-001-001 (Engine Oil Change), VMC-001-002 (Oil Filter), VMC-001-003 (Air Filter), VMC-001-004 (Wheel Alignment), VMC-001-005 (General Servicing)

**VMC-G-002 - Repairs & Replacements:**
- VMC-002-001 (Brake Pads), VMC-002-002 (Battery), VMC-002-003 (Tyres), VMC-002-004 (Clutch), VMC-002-005 (Suspension)

**VMC-G-003 - Electrical & AC:**
- VMC-003-001 (AC Service), VMC-003-002 (Electrical Wiring), VMC-003-003 (Alternator/Starter), VMC-003-004 (Lights)

**VMC-G-004 - Body & Exterior:**
- VMC-004-001 (Denting & Painting), VMC-004-002 (Windshield), VMC-004-003 (Body Parts), VMC-004-004 (Washing & Cleaning)

**VMC-G-005 - Engine & Transmission:**
- VMC-005-001 (Engine Overhaul), VMC-005-002 (Gearbox), VMC-005-003 (Radiator), VMC-005-004 (Fuel System)

**VMC-G-006 - Miscellaneous:**
- VMC-006-001 (Accessories), VMC-006-002 (GPS/Tracking Device), VMC-006-003 (Other)
- VMC-006-003 requires: custom_cost_label

**VMC-G-007 - Wheels & Tires:**
- VMC-007-001 (Tire Rotation), VMC-007-002 (Wheel Alignment), VMC-007-003 (Tire Replacement)

## Permissions
- Add/Edit: All roles
- Delete: Owner, GM, Manager only
